title: Restore bg-white on shop component surfaces, keep dark page wrappers
body:
A blanket `bg-white` → `bg-zinc-950` sweep across `shop/packages/Webkul/Shop/src/Resources/views/components` darkened interactive surfaces that were never meant to be dark (inputs, dropdowns, modals, cards), leaving light-on-light and dark-on-dark text. This restores `bg-white` on those component surfaces and confines the dark background to page-level wrappers.

### Restored to `bg-white`
- **Products**: `products/card.blade.php` card body, wishlist/compare buttons, and `bg-zinc-950/80` → `bg-white/80` rating badges
- **Overlays**: `drawer/index` (cart panel), `dropdown/index`, `accordion/index`, `modal/index`, `modal/confirm`
- **Datagrid**: `datagrid/table`, `shimmer/datagrid/index`, and toolbar controls (`filter`, `search`, `pagination`, `mass-action`)
- **Forms**: input/select backgrounds and the toggle thumb in `form/control-group/control.blade.php`; all `[&::*-thumb]:bg-*` variants in `range-slider/index`
- **Misc light surfaces**: `image-zoomer`, `categories/carousel` arrows, `shimmer/categories/filters`, and the mobile sign-up button (navyBlue text was sitting on near-black)

### Left dark
`layouts/header/index`, the mobile bottom nav bar, `layouts/footer/index`, and the `#app` wrapper in `layouts/index`. `app.css` is untouched.

Note that upstream Bagisto values that were already dark (e.g. the `bg-zinc-100` modal panel shell) were left as-is; only backgrounds originating from the sweep were reverted. Border/text color changes from the same theme work are out of scope here.

```diff
-<div class="pointer-events-auto h-full w-full overflow-auto bg-zinc-950">
+<div class="pointer-events-auto h-full w-full overflow-auto bg-white">
```
